desc: Ideation: select an O(n) method (KMP prefix-function on reverse(S) + sentinel + S) to find the longest palindromic suffix.
Read S from stdin and compute n = len(S).
Build t = reverse(S) + sentinel + S and compute the prefix-function array pi.
Set k = pi[-1] as the longest palindromic suffix length.
Construct and print the answer S + reverse(S[:n-k]).
Test on samples (ABC, Z, TREE), edge cases (n=1, already palindrome, all same char, random), and verify linear time for n=500000.
